title: Exact H2/D2 equilibrium bond-length relation
statement: For the complete registered gas-phase H2/D2 X-state boundary, the common Fold electronic base is seven-fifths of the held atomic-length carrier. The binary-order alpha return adds twenty-one alpha squared for H2 and twenty-four alpha squared for D2. Thus r_e(H2)/a0=7/5+21 alpha^2 and r_e(D2)/a0=7/5+24 alpha^2 before either NIST distance target is released.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of molecular identity, equilibrium ownership, scale, common base, correction order, isotopologue route, measurement custody and extension forms; decide all 256 from the admitted Fold support and spectroscopy carriers.
grammar_boundary: The complete registered H2 and D2 homonuclear-hydrogen X 1Sigma_g+ gas-phase equilibrium-distance vector, using one held atomic-length reference, the exact alpha carrier and each generated up, down, generator and terminal support only in its typed slot.

choices.name: generic-diatomic-with-erased-state
choices.reason: A generic diatomic label cannot own a quantitative molecular value.

choices.name: named-isotopologue-state-and-condition
choices.reason: Species, isotopologue, electronic state and gas-phase condition remain held.

choices.reason: A sampled distance is not the generated equilibrium fixed point.

choices.reason: The admitted same-dimension atomic-length carrier transports the exact ratio.

choices.name: free-leading-ratio
choices.reason: A chosen leading ratio can place the prediction near any target.

choices.name: up-support-over-down-support
choices.reason: The forced molecular up/down supports supply the common electronic base seven-fifths.

choices.name: linear-or-open-correction-series
choices.reason: A linear or open series has no typed closure and can be extended to fit.

choices.name: binary-order-alpha-return
choices.reason: The binary return forces the first closed correction at exact alpha squared.

choices.name: one-universal-isotope-correction
choices.reason: One correction erases the admitted nuclear-support distinction.

choices.name: distinct-light-and-heavy-typed-routes
choices.reason: H2 uses generator-times-up; D2 uses terminal-plus-up-plus-One.

choices.name: target-readable-or-selected-value
choices.reason: Target-readable execution cannot provide an empirical prediction seal.

choices.name: sealed-exact-interval-transport
choices.reason: Exact multipliers and the public scale input are sealed before the target vector opens.

choices.name: free-species-term-or-fit
choices.reason: A species correction not generated by the typed boundary is a free parameter.

choices.name: finite-typed-vector-exhaustion
choices.reason: The registered H2/D2 typed routes are exhausted and halt without another term.

induction_base: The admitted equal electronic support fixes one common up/down equilibrium base for the light homonuclear state; the binary alpha return supplies its first closed positive correction.
induction_step: Replacing both retained light nuclei by the admitted heavy isotope preserves the common electronic base and forces the distinct terminal-plus-up-plus-One correction route; the two-row registered vector is then exhausted.
exclusions: no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, signed or continuum proof value
no NIST distance, CODATA scale inscription or angstrom conversion in the executable law
no imported wavefunction, potential, rigid-rotor length equation or conventional molecular model
no fitted bond parameter, selected decimal coefficient, species lookup or free correction term
no target access before the exact interval vector is sealed
no claim beyond the registered H2/D2 X-state gas-phase boundary
operational_witnesses: The common equilibrium base is exactly up-support over down-support.
H2 and D2 correction counts close as 21 and 24 from their distinct typed routes.
Both multipliers are exact positive fractions and the retained heavy-isotope route is larger.

falsification_condition: The claim fails if either exact sealed physical interval does not overlap its complete NIST displayed equilibrium-distance interval; if species, isotopologue, X state, gas-phase condition, CODATA scale provenance or source uncertainty is erased; if either target is readable before sealing; if any extra coefficient or species rule is appended; or if a deliberately displaced interval is accepted.
